reads_as_reason: Surfaces are clean and coherent, but the thigh is a near-constant-width rounded slab and the shank top is a flat slanted chop with no designed knee: a blank test piece.

G1.evidence: Calm adult tube, no chibi proportions; thigh is a slab-like rounded rectangle with a nearly parallel outline (agrees with failed S4a 0.4341 and P8a 0.708). One leg segment is too little to call product or toy.

G2.evidence: Each segment flows cleanly and the zebra is coherent, but the knee is not a designed joint: slanted cut with a flat elliptical shelf in the back view; thigh bottom is a simple rounded end; the gap reads as a seam, not a recess.

G3.evidence: Dark recess colour not rendered; the slanted cut and open gap behind the thigh could take a dark fill but are not shaped like a recess.

G4.evidence: Same rounded-rectangle section, similar corner radii and soft end caps on thigh and shank; zebra bands run parallel with no wobble.

G6.evidence: No references. Smooth rounded-rectangle shells and shank taper resemble Optimus / Atlas leg covers; thigh too parallel and knee has no cap or recess.

pairwise.evidence: The baseline shank is lumpy with a waisted S-curve and bulges at calf and ankle, zebra breaks into noisy patches. The candidate has a clean tapered shank, smooth parallel zebra and a more convincing calf swell. Both share the flat slanted knee cut and slab thigh.

top_changes.change: Design the knee: round the shank top into a convex front cap and recessed back; add a visible joint gap or neck.
Taper the thigh further toward the knee (P8a 0.708 vs 0.65) and the shank toward the ankle (P8b 0.712 vs 0.6).
Reduce flat panels (S4a 0.4341 vs 0.3): lower the superellipse exponent for more crown.

notes: One leg segment only; recess colour not rendered. Back view shows a flat horizontal shelf at the shank top (cutter floor).
